event_questions.label: E1
event_questions.not_this: Ordinary notice with a notice period, however short, or release from work while a notice period runs.
event_questions.question: Did the employer end the employment relationship with immediate effect, without a notice period?

questions.label: Q1
questions.not_this: A notice period that only the termination letter states, with no written contract term behind it.
questions.question: Does the file say that a written individual employment contract, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract sets notice periods different from the statutory ones (seven days during probation, art. 335b para. 1; one month in the first year of service, two months in the second to ninth years, three months thereafter)?

questions.label: Q2
questions.not_this: An oral arrangement about probation, or a remark only that the employee was still new.
questions.question: Does the file say that a written individual agreement, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract set a probation period other than the first month of employment?

questions.label: Q3
questions.not_this: Incapacity the employee caused through their own fault; days of incapacity beyond the 30, 90 or 180 days; incapacity that ended before notice was given or began only after the notice period had ended.
questions.question: Was the employee, through no fault of their own, wholly or partly prevented from working by illness or accident on the day notice was given or at some time while the notice period was running, and was the incapacity at that point still within its protected length: up to 30 days in the first year of service, 90 days in the second to fifth years, 180 days from the sixth year?

questions.label: Q4
questions.not_this: Voluntary service, service in a foreign army, a service of eleven days or less that did not overlap the notice day or the notice period, or an overseas aid project (art. 336c para. 1 let. d, not covered here).
questions.question: Was the employee performing Swiss compulsory military service, civil defence service or alternative civilian service on the day notice was given or while the notice period was running, or, for such a service lasting more than eleven days, did either of those fall within the four weeks before or after it?

questions.label: Q5
questions.not_this: Notice given on a day that already fell inside the protected period (that notice is void, not suspended). Not asked where no protected period is raised.
questions.question: Where a protected period (illness or accident, compulsory service, pregnancy or birth, as above) is raised: was the notice given before that period began, with the notice period not yet expired when it began?

questions.label: Q6
questions.not_this: A resignation by the employee, a fixed-term relationship that ended by running out, or a dismissal with immediate effect (art. 337, a separate type).
questions.question: Did the employer give the employee notice of termination of the employment relationship?

questions.label: Q7
questions.not_this: Notice given after the probation period, with any such extension, had expired.
questions.question: Was the notice given while the probation period was still running, counting any extension of the probation period under art. 335b para. 3 (a probation period interrupted by illness, accident or a non-voluntary legal obligation is extended accordingly)?

questions.label: Q8
questions.not_this: Pregnancy of the employee's partner; the further leave periods of art. 336c para. 1 let. cbis to cquinquies, which this rule set does not cover.
questions.question: Was the employee pregnant, or within sixteen weeks after giving birth, on the day notice was given or while the notice period was running?

routing.question: Which employment-termination dispute does the claim concern? protected_period_notice: an ordinary notice of termination by the employer where the claim concerns whether it is valid or when the employment ends, because of the probation period, an incapacity through illness or accident, compulsory service, pregnancy or birth, or the notice period (CO arts. 335b, 335c, 336c). wrongful_termination: an ordinary notice by the employer that the claim contests as abusive (given for an improper reason, such as retaliation for claims or an employee representative's mandate), or against which the employee objects or claims compensation (CO arts. 336-336b). immediate_dismissal: a dismissal with immediate effect, without a notice period (CO arts. 337-337c).

text:
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren

Ich arbeite als Lagerist bei der Steinbruch Genossenschaft in Kreuzlingen. Seit Ende Juni lebe ich in grosser Unsicherheit und möchte wissen, woran ich bin.

Am 30. Juni 2026 hat Frau Martina Kaufmann, die Geschäftsführerin, alle im Lager zusammengerufen und gesagt, die Genossenschaft müsse "Kosten sparen" und es werde "nicht für alle weitergehen". Danach hat sie mich und meine Kollegin Rahel Imhof noch einzeln ins Büro geholt und gefragt, ob wir uns schon einmal nach etwas anderem umgesehen hätten.

Eine Kündigung habe ich aber nicht bekommen, weder schriftlich noch mündlich. Frau Kaufmann hat nie gesagt, dass ich gehen muss, sie redet nur um den heissen Brei herum. Seither werde ich bei der Einsatzplanung immer wieder übergangen, und Aufgaben, die ich jahrelang gemacht habe, macht jetzt ein Temporärer.

Frau Kaufmann hat im Gespräch auch gefragt, ob ich demnächst ins Militär müsse, weil sie die Einsätze im Herbst planen wolle. Ich habe ihr gesagt, wie es ist: Ich habe keinen Militärdienst, keinen Zivilschutz und keinen Zivildienst, weder jetzt noch in den letzten Monaten, und es steht auch nichts an. Daran kann es also nicht liegen.

Ich verdiene CHF 3320 im Monat und habe eine Familie zu ernähren. Was kann ich tun, damit ich nicht plötzlich ohne Stelle dastehe? Muss ich jetzt schon etwas unternehmen, oder soll ich abwarten?

Freundliche Grüsse
Adrian Gerber
Wiesenstrasse 93
8280 Kreuzlingen
